units.source_text: “我们就这样走着，曝晒加上疲劳，身体状况自然有些不正常了。

en.t: As we walked on like that, the blazing sun and our fatigue naturally left our bodies in a somewhat abnormal state.

units.source_text: 不过，这跟生病不一样，感觉自己的灵魂进入别人身体里去了似的。

en.t: Still, it was different from being ill; it felt as if my own soul had entered someone else's body.

units.source_text: 我虽然像平常那样跟K说话，却游离于平常的心情了，

en.t: Although I spoke with K just as I usually did, I had drifted away from my ordinary state of mind,

units.source_text: 我对他的亲切和憎恶，仿佛都带着旅行中才会有的异样感觉。

en.t: and both my fondness for him and my hatred seemed tinged with the strange feeling that comes only while traveling.

units.source_text: 就是说，酷热、下海和步行，使我们之间形成了有别于以往的新关系吧。

en.t: In other words, the heat, the sea bathing, and the walking must have formed a new relationship between us, different from before.

units.source_text: 那时我们恰如结伴上路的行商，

en.t: At that time we were just like peddlers who had happened to set out on the road together,

units.source_text: 无论怎样聊天也不同于在家时那样，根本触及不到需要费脑筋思考的复杂问题。

en.t: and no matter how much we talked, unlike when we were at home, we never touched on complicated questions that required serious thought.

units.source_text: 就这样我们终于走到了铫子。

en.t: In this way we finally walked as far as Choshi.

units.source_text: 途中只发生了一件事，令我至今无法忘记。

en.t: Only one thing happened along the way, and I still cannot forget it even now.

units.source_text: 没离开房州之前，我们到一个叫小凑的地方，游览了鲷鱼湾。

en.t: Before leaving Boshu, we went to a place called Kominato and visited Tainoura Bay.

units.source_text: 由于那是多年前的事，而且我也没有太大兴趣，记不大清了，

en.t: Because it happened many years ago, and because I was not especially interested, I do not remember it very clearly,

units.source_text: 据说那地方是日莲诞生的村子。

en.t: but I was told that the place was the village where Nichiren was born.

units.source_text: 传说日莲诞生的那天，有两条鲷鱼被海浪冲上了海滩，

en.t: According to the legend, on the day Nichiren was born, two sea bream were washed up onto the shore by the waves,

units.source_text: 从此以后，村里的渔夫们就不敢捕鲷鱼了，

en.t: and from then on the fishermen of the village no longer dared to catch sea bream,

units.source_text: 这个习俗一直保留到今天，所以海湾里鲷鱼非常多。

en.t: a custom that has been preserved down to the present, so there are many sea bream in the bay.

units.source_text: 我们专门雇了一条小船，前去观赏鲷鱼。

en.t: We hired a small boat especially so that we could go and see the sea bream.
